name: portals
title: Portals
description:
Navigate any hierarchy of URLs with instant keyboard-driven browsing.

Add folders and links, organize them into nested trees, pin favorites, and open directly in your browser.

Works with any website, deep link, or local path — no API or account required.
author: BinaryBlitz10

commands.name: browse-folders
commands.title: Open Portals
commands.description: Navigate your portal hierarchy. Pin favorites, open URLs in browser, copy links, and browse nested folders with a full detail panel showing path, description, and contents.

commands.name: manage-folders
commands.title: Edit Portals
commands.description: Add, edit, delete, and reorganize your portals. Set descriptions, move folders anywhere in the tree, and export or import your entire folder structure as JSON for backup or sharing.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
